expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon above it, while 'Home', 'Search', and 'Profile' all have icons. This leaves an empty gap and makes the tab look broken/unloaded, and it also misaligns the label baseline relative to the other tabs.

The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card the heart sits directly on the image with no backdrop, while on the pizza card below it has a dark circular background. This makes the control harder to see on lighter imagery and looks unintentional.
The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is rendered in a very light gray on a light gray fill, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the Orders tab in the bottom nav bar missing its icon while other tabs have icons, matching the expected defect.
